So `override_mode or field.mode` will always be `"validation"`.

Computed fields in Pydantic v2 are only present during serialization, not validation.
If we force `"validation"` mode, computed fields will be omitted because they are not part of the validation schema.

This is because `json_schema_serialization_defaults_required = True` is set in `model_config`.

When `override_mode="serialization"`, Pydantic uses the serialization schema. With `json_schema_serialization_defaults_required = True`, it marks fields with defaults as required in the schema because they will always be present in the serialized output.
